commits.description: Close staged bank inputs over LS snapshots and linked tapes; production-reader parity CPU tests

acceptance.resume_verification: Implementation, tests and prior readiness receipt matched the reviewed commit exactly before this receipt-only update. Existing accepted CPU results reused; no jobs or dispatches started.

dependencies.reason: P4 requires only existing production bank-reader rules present on c4/track-base; no optional component-module dependency.
dependencies.runtime: Python standard library only; no torch or simulator import in staging_closure

api.input: Iterable of reader-selected inventory FILE paths; a single str/Path is also accepted. Directories and an empty inventory are refused.
api.output_files: Sorted absolute paths, including lexical aliases and physical link targets. Stage every returned file; aliases may be materialized as regular copies.

manifest.entries: Absolute POSIX path -> {sha256, bytes, resolved_path, readers}
manifest.allowed_roots: File-parent roots derived from the full closure, including resolved link targets
manifest.manifest_sha256: SHA256 of canonical JSON excluding this field: sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False

api.mirror: For /home/ubuntu envelope episode_path references, infer the filesystem-root mirror from input paths containing home/ubuntu; mirror= can bind it explicitly. No host-path fallback when a mirror is bound.
api.failure_behavior: Missing required input raises FileNotFoundError; prohibited paths, unsafe identifiers, malformed generation layout, invalid result payload paths and digest/size mismatches refuse with ValueError. Snapshots remain opaque hashed bytes.

reader_rules: replay_bank._receipts: labels/<search_id>[_GENERATION].json -> branches/<verification_id>/<branch>/RESULT.json or label_attempts/<GENERATION>/branches/<verification_id>/<branch>/RESULT.json; existing observable traces included
replay_bank._decision_snapshot and practice_starts.load_snapshot: decisions/<state>.json state_id -> own snapshots/<state_id>.pt
replay_bank._ls_snapshot: LS label search_id -> pending/<search_id>.json.gz -> snapshots/<envelope.snapshot>.pt.gz + envelope.episode_path/RESULT.json
accel_storage.read: coopmwm-lossless-gzip-v1 RESULT.json marker -> RESULT.json.gz; decompressed SHA256 and declared byte length verified
solo_seed2_links.wire: directory-link branch views -> physical external source files, without a hand-written list of source run names

coverage: Original and generation-specific LS layouts checked against actual replay_bank._receipts and _decision_snapshot
Own decision snapshot checked against actual snapshot reader; closure prohibited from unpickling
RESULT marker parity with actual accel_storage.read
External warm1 receipt-view targets and compressed payloads using Windows directory junction fallback when symlink privilege is absent
Deterministic manifest, byte hashes, deduplication and mutation sensitivity
Missing pending/snapshot/episode marker/episode payload/branch marker fail closed
Prohibited direct and linked target paths refused before file open
Unsafe path identifiers, invalid generations, skipped labels, plain results and empty/directory inventories

integration_handoff: T2C should pass its reader-selected inventory file paths into closure before final staging manifest hashing.
Use every returned path, incorporate manifest.allowed_roots into local root admission and map them through the existing mirror-to-remote conversion.
Keep the closure receipt and alias map with the final SHA staging manifest. No shared rerun module was edited by P4.
verification_scope: Synthetic CPU fixtures only; live staged corpus validation belongs to the T2C/S-LAUNCH integration gate.
